title: Warm support connects different needs

captions.emotions: Feeling conversation and personal activity harmonise

meaning: Your open warmth can offer harmony when dependable organisation leaves room for both shared time and a personal activity.
text: Dependable support can leave more room for different needs. In the physical position of Anahata, the Sun shows openly warm actions: expressing pleasure in presence and friendly attention directly. The Emperor in energy brings a wish to arrange clear conditions that can be relied upon. Temperance in emotions offers harmony when different needs do not destroy each other. Spending time together may matter alongside finishing a personal activity. Tenderness connects these wishes through a concrete agreement rather than requiring closeness proved by immediately abandoning one for the sake of the other or treating one interest as unimportant.

For example, one warmly proposes dinner together and promises food ready at a clear time. The other needs to finish work on a drawing. **A dependable invitation leaves time to finish personal work.** Time can be agreed without continual reminders and dinner happen later. Care connects wanting conversation with room to finish what was begun, while an open gesture does not secure the whole evening in gratitude for cooking.

Difficulty appears if organisation makes timing a rigid way to control a response. Alternatively, harmony means continual concession from whoever has a supposedly less important activity. Attention remembers both needs. Promises can be fulfilled and timing changes discussed without making either a personal drawing or a request to finish later proof of ingratitude, coldness or weak shared desire to stay close.
